facts.text: The resort encompasses three private islands.
The resort is a 40-minute seaplane ride from Male International Airport, or reached by speedboat transfer.
facts.excerpt: is a 40-minute seaplane ride from Malé International Airport or speedboat transfer

facts.text: The resort is in the Lhaviyani Atoll.
Accommodation is beach, family and overwater pool villas, with the lagoon at your feet.
facts.excerpt: spacious beach, family, and overwater pool villas, the lagoon is at your feet, where the vibrant house reef protects our bustling marine life

facts.text: Villas range from one to three bedrooms, suiting couples, families and larger groups.
facts.excerpt: Villas range from one-bedroom to three-bedroom, offering a vast array of accommodation options suitable for couples, families and larger groups alike.

facts.text: A Marine Biology team monitors and protects turtles, coral and seagrass across the atoll year-round, sharing progress through talks and in-water experiences.
facts.excerpt: our Marine Biology team, who monitor and protect turtles, coral, and seagrass across the atoll year-round, sharing their progress via talks and in-water experiences

facts.text: At the Earth Lab, guests turn everyday waste into something useful through workshops.
facts.excerpt: Our Earth Lab is where guests and hosts turn everyday waste — glass, paper, food scraps — into something useful, through workshops

facts.text: Sustainability Tours showcase the water bottling plant, Organic Garden and Orchid Garden.
facts.excerpt: We offer Sustainability Tours, where we showcase our operations, such as our water bottling plant, Organic Garden, Orchid Garden, and energy conservation efforts.

facts.text: Guests can have a castaway experience on two deserted islands just off Kanuhura.
facts.excerpt: Castaway experience on two deserted islands just off the shores of Kanuhura.

facts.text: Multi-bedroom villas are available both on the beach and over the water.
facts.excerpt: A vast array of multi-bedroom villas on the beach and over water call for the perfect tropical family escape.

facts.text: Diving is offered at sites in the Lhaviyani Atoll.
facts.excerpt: Diving in some of the most diverse, vibrant, and colorful sites in the Maldives.

facts.text: Watersports include paddling and sailing, with activities in, on or under the sea.
facts.excerpt: Splash, paddle, sail, or fall in the turquoise waters, choosing from an array of activities in, on, or under the sea.

facts.text: A castaway lunch island is a boat ride away, and a third island is left entirely to nature.
facts.excerpt: a castaway lunch island just a boat ride away, and a third left entirely to nature and your imagination

facts.text: The atoll is surrounded by turquoise waters, vibrant reefs and white beaches.
facts.excerpt: Our beautiful Lhaviyani atoll home is surrounded by turquoise waters, vibrant reefs, and endless white beaches.
